environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on Tomcat 9.0.78+ behind AWS CloudFront distribution with a custom response headers policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) that appends 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'' to ALL origin responses. CloudFront also normalizes response headers by stripping any response header containing CR (0x0D) or LF (0x0A) characters in header values per its HTTP/2 framing requirements (RFC 9113 Section 8.2.1 compliance). The Tomcat version 9.0.78+ additionally rejects header values containing \r or \n with an IllegalArgumentException in the Coyote connector before the response is committed.

config.cdn: AWS CloudFront with response headers policy
